paragraphs.text: Spy is a creature type , describing those who engage in clandestine operations. It is the main class of the Agents of S.N.E.A.K. faction on Bablovia . They are often seen with strange gadgets or contraptions used to assist in their missions.

Spy was originally introduced as a legal creature type in Alliances on Stromgald Spy , however, it was incorporated into the Rogue class in the Grand Creature Type Update . The type was then reintroduced as a Silver-bordered class in Unstable , and became Eternal legal again with Marvel Super Heroes . With Marvel Super Heroes it was mainly used to represent members of agencies like S.H.I.E.L.D. .
